name: webexport
comment: Web Export Houdini package. Portable: paths derive from $HOUDINI_PACKAGE_PATH (the folder that holds THIS file = <repo>/packages). Either add <repo>/packages to HOUDINI_PACKAGE_DIR, or run scripts/install_package.py to deploy a resolved copy into your Houdini user prefs. Uses hpath (the Houdini 22 keyword) and load_package_once so a deployed copy and HOUDINI_PACKAGE_DIR pointing here cannot double-load. Pattern adapted from SYNAPSE packages/synapse.json at commit 36148779 (MIT).
